title: Semantic Density, Ellipsis, and Poetic Weight in Non-Fiction

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: In Hungarian modernist essays, elegance is achieved not by ornamentation, but by radical stripping away (*szikár stílus*). Words carry immense associative weight, and silence (*a csend jelenléte*) becomes an active syntactic element.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Semantic compression (*jelentéssűrítés*) relies on juxtapositions where subordinate conjunctions are omitted, forcing the reader to contemplate the stark conceptual clash.

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: Szikár, dísztelen, mégis mélyen megrendítő próza...
Austere, unadorned, yet profoundly moving prose...
The extraordinary semantic compression of words...
A kihagyás és a csend művészete...
The art of ellipsis and silence...
